title: docs(pm-dispatch): decision card before popup — AskUserQuestion becomes a presence accelerator
body:
Fixes #11212

## What this lands

The pm-dispatch skill's own description already routes maintainer decisions to `needs-user-decision` cards, but the body never stated the **order** between a card and a blocking popup. Seats therefore read `AskUserQuestion` as the default channel: the whole seat round halts while one is pending, and its content lands on no queryable surface — not on a card, not visible to sibling seats, not sweepable, not batch-answerable when the maintainer returns.

Three rules now sit in `## 升级与决策`, immediately after the four-axis frame — the paragraph a seat is reading at the exact moment it is deciding whether to ask:

1. **卡先于弹窗** — any maintainer-decision need files the `needs-user-decision` card as its **first action** (options + recommendation + evidence + facet block, the same content the popup would carry); the blocked execution card takes `pm:blocked` + `Blocked-by:` pointing at it **in the same write**; the rest of the queue keeps moving — never idle the whole seat on a pending answer.
2. **弹窗仅作加速器,带在场判据** — `AskUserQuestion` is allowed only when the maintainer has given human input in **this session within ~30 minutes**; every ask carries a recommended option; a Skip or a long-pending ask falls back to the card channel and is **never re-popped**. Because the card exists first, however the popup dies the board stays honest.
3. **回批入口** — the maintainer saying 「处理决策卡」 sweeps every open decision card for one batch ruling. This is written as the standing trigger for the already-ruled 「我会定期和ai讨论」 consumption path, and explicitly **not** a revival of the retired periodic decision-summary issue (2026-08-19 ruling) — the two are one line apart in the same paragraph, so a later reader cannot mistake one for the other.

The old closing sentence 「交互会话可另发 `AskUserQuestion`,带标签的 issue 恒为持久记录」 — the permissive default this card is about — is gone.

## Landing ruling (verbatim, untranslated)

Maintainer, 2026-08-23: 「A:立即派发,真删付账(推荐)」

No ceiling was raised. Payment is genuine deletion in the same file.

## Payment ledger — `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, 682 → 682 lines

Ceiling 682, headroom 0 before and after. Every deletion is text another **covered** file already owns verbatim, or a narrative the ratchet's own verdict message rules out of operational text. No re-wrap was used as a source of lines: each reflow below is the consequence of characters actually removed.

| # | Deleted from SKILL.md | Why it is a true duplicate |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | 「六项写法要求(一句话问题、客户可感知代价的选项表、业务直译与行业类比、四轴业务论证、推荐+回退+置信缺口带低摩擦裁决格式、裁后执行段)」 and 「四棱块固定形状(首行机器可寻标记、四棱各一行中文、字母选项、**强制置信缺口行「本分析看不见什么」**)」 (~127 chars) | `references/decision-analysis.md` §落卡分析模板 numbers those six items 1–6 in full, and §四棱卡面块固定形状 owns the block shape in full. The **same sentence** already said 细则见 that file — this is the collapse-to-pointer the compressed references exist for. Kept as the named list 「落卡分析模板、写法六项、适用边界与四棱块固定形状」. |
| D2 | 「—— 只约束 `needs-user-decision` 卡与决策箱讨论,dev 派发四维照旧、不强加行业类比;只管新记录,存量 ⛔ 不回改。」 (~71 chars) | `references/decision-analysis.md` §适用面(边界) owns both boundary rules verbatim. Folded into the pointer as the word 「适用边界」. |
| D3 | 「(维护者 2026-08-20 裁定,原话:「四维分析应该从业务的角度写我才好判断」;实测:实现视角让维护者追问一轮,业务视角当场裁决)」 (~68 chars) | `references/decision-analysis.md` lines 3–5 are that ruling's 出处: same date, same verbatim quote, same 实测, in fuller form. SKILL.md keeps the rule + date and now says 「细则连同出处原话见」 so the words are one hop away, not lost. |
| D4 | 「—— 块标准化把提取从 LLM 理解题降级成 grep」 (~48 chars incl. surrounding punctuation) | Same rationale is owned by `references/decision-analysis.md` §四棱卡面块固定形状 (「首行**机器可寻固定标记**…提取按字面文本 grep,不依赖注释形状」). |
| D5 | 「—— 案例(2026-08-15):两张四棱同向、低风险、全绿、已复核的 PR 仍因分析看不见的方向性前提被整体作废 ——」 (~61 chars) | A story in operational text. The ratchet's own red message and the file header both rule 「stories live on cards, not in operational text」. Its operative residue 「推荐是输入,永不是放行,人工地板不变」 is **retained** verbatim. |
| D6 | 云卡四课's four titles 「(① 授权面随 source 不随环境;② 派发词必带自驱条款;③ 交付通道 = 自开 draft PR + 终报 issue 评论;④ draft PR 一存在立即 `subscribe_pr_activity` 硬步骤)」 (~106 chars) | `references/dispatch-runbook.md` §云卡四课 carries all four as numbered bold headings with their full text. The same sentence says 全文见 runbook. Now reads 「**云卡四课全文见 runbook**」. |
| D7 | 「(全仓一轮翻完;翻转后的pin 断言新语义的实质,真非法形状的拒收断言逐字保留 —— 丢第二句就退化成「全仓删光」)」 (~60 chars) | `references/dispatch-runbook.md` §派发词构造细则 → 「**全仓 pin 清扫两句原文**」 owns both sentences in fuller form, and the section header already points there. Now reads 「两句缺一不可(两句原文见 runbook)」. |

**Line math (per file, the only file touched)**

| Region | before | after | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| 派发词原则 pin-sweep bullet (D7) | 4 | 3 | −1 |
| 云卡四课 paragraph (D6) | 3 | 2 | −1 |
| 升级与决策 tail paragraph (D1–D5 out, rules 1–3 in, +1 blank separator) | 14 | 16 | +2 |
| **file total** | **682** | **682** | **0** |

Character accounting for the tail paragraph: 820 chars before → 859 after; ~375 chars of duplication removed, ~414 chars of new rule text added. The paragraph grew in content and shrank in duplication — it did not get re-wrapped tighter.

Nothing was compressed lossily: no rule changed meaning, and every deleted passage's full text still exists, verbatim, in a file the surviving sentence points at.

## Frame isomorphism

The four-axis frame block (`check:skill-frame-sync`, 4 hand-written copies across 3 files) was **not** touched — the start anchor, the axis entries and the binding sentence 「推荐意见必须基于这四条轴给出理由」 are byte-identical; only text *after* the binding sentence moved. Gate re-run and green below.
